name: Medusa
prompt_name: Medusa store with Medusa's Next.js storefront

products: SELECT count(*) FROM product WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
orderStatus: psql -U medusa -d medusa -tAc "SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cart_payment_collection c JOIN order_cart o ON o.cart_id = c.cart_id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.payment_collection_id = s.payment_collection_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_session_id = s.id AND p.captured_at IS NOT NULL) THEN 'paid' ELSE 'awaiting_payment' END FROM payment_session s WHERE s.id = '$1'"
